reason: The test part is the last 60 days of history at the time of decision (the lower end of the 60-90 days the plan allows for 'the last months'). Everything earlier is kept for training so that previous winters stay in the training data. A 7-day gap separates train from test because features look back up to 7 days. Days after test_end_date are new live days: they may be added only when training v2.
